coverage_note: Hand-curated for the Phase 5C CourtBuilder vertical slice only. Covers 5 franchises, not the full NBA. Does NOT claim complete team-season rosters -- only lists the subset of each roster that is also present in the existing 250-player PEAK3 card pool (data/game/profiles/card_profiles.v3.json). Not wired into, and not a substitute for, the real team_identity/team_season/team_season_roster_member schema proposed in docs/architecture/PHASE_5_DATA_MODEL.md. Deleted (not migrated) once real team-season data acquisition happens.

Public record: Celtics 1981/1984/1986 championship rosters (Big Three era).
Public record: Celtics 2007-08 championship roster (Garnett/Pierce/Allen 'Big Three').

Public record: Spurs 2003/2005/2007 championship rosters (Duncan, Ginobili).
Public record: Warriors 2015/2017/2018 championship rosters (Curry throughout; Durant joined July 2016).

exact_team_season_spins.source_provenance: Public record: 1990-91 Chicago Bulls roster (first championship team). Dennis Rodman was on the Detroit Pistons this season, not the Bulls -- deliberately excluded here even though he appears in the 1990s decade spin above.
Public record: 1986-87 Los Angeles Lakers championship roster.
Public record: 2015-16 Golden State Warriors (73-9) roster. Kevin Durant did not join the Warriors until July 2016 -- deliberately excluded here even though he appears in the 2010s decade spin above.
